m144.overview: Two angels, Damiel and Cassiel, glide through the streets of Berlin, observing the bustling population, providing invisible rays of hope to the distressed but never interacting with them. When Damiel falls in love with lonely trapeze artist Marion, the angel longs to experience life in the physical world, and finds — with some words of wisdom from actor Peter Falk — that it might be possible for him to take human form.

m1440098.title: Drawn Together
m1440098.overview: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.

m1440718.title: Bono: Stories of Surrender
m1440718.overview: Through words, music, and mischief, Bono pulls back the curtain on his deeply personal experiences that have shaped him as a son, father, husband, activist, and U2 frontman.

m1445363.title: EPiC: Elvis Presley in Concert
m1445363.overview: Long-lost footage from Elvis Presley's legendary Las Vegas residency in the 1970s woven together with rare 16mm footage from Elvis on Tour, and 8mm from the Graceland archive, plus recordings of Elvis telling "his side of the story" rediscovered during Baz Luhrmann's research for his 2022 film, Elvis.

m14462.title: The Manchurian Candidate
m14462.overview: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw, now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return.

m14478.title: Adventures of Ali-Baba and the Forty Thieves
m14478.overview: A village man accidentally uncovers a web of political intrigue after discovering and distributing treasures from Hussain's secret hideout. The Khazi sets a gang of ruthless bandits on the man to ensure the safety of his treasures.Based on the story of Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves from the 1001 Nights or Arabian Tales.

m1447853.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
m1447853.overview: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

m1448497.title: Ocean with David Attenborough
m1448497.overview: David Attenborough takes viewers on a breathtaking journey showing there is nowhere more vital for our survival, more full of life, wonder, or surprise, than the ocean. Through spectacular sequences featuring coral reefs, kelp forests and the open ocean, Attenborough shares why a healthy ocean keeps the entire planet stable and flourishing.

m1448970.title: Disturbia
m1448970.overview: Before our very eyes a strange human-bird hybrid undergoes constant transformation to cope with the omnipresent tensions of economical, ideological, military, and climatic threats.

m1451867.title: Ghost Elephants
m1451867.overview: In Angola's mist-shrouded highlands, three KhoiSan master trackers embark on a spiritual quest to rediscover the legendary "ghost elephants" of Lisima, creatures presumed lost but remembered in ancestral trance, ritual, and memory.

m1452.title: Superman Returns
m1452.overview: Superman returns to discover his 5-year absence has allowed Lex Luthor to walk free, and that those he was closest to felt abandoned and have moved on. Luthor plots his ultimate revenge that could see millions killed and change the face of the planet forever, as well as ridding himself of the Man of Steel.

m1453407.title: Gajab Raat
m1453407.overview: A corrupt, troubled cop's night spirals out of control when a reluctant act of mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.

m1455079.title: You, Me & Tuscany
m1455079.overview: When a woman crashes at an empty Italian villa, posing as the owner's fiancée, she discovers an unexpected romance that could transform her life.

m14560.title: Paul Blart: Mall Cop
m14560.overview: When a shopping mall is taken over by a gang of organized crooks, it's up to a mild-mannered security guard to save the day.

m14564.title: Rings
m14564.overview: Julia becomes worried about her boyfriend Holt when he explores the dark urban legend of a mysterious videotape said to kill the watcher seven days after viewing. She sacrifices herself to save her boyfriend and in doing so makes a horrifying discovery: there is a "movie within the movie" that no one has ever seen before.

m1457124.title: Titanic: The Digital Resurrection
m1457124.overview: Using cutting-edge scanning technology and state-of-the-art CGI, a team of experts creates the first high-resolution 3D digital twin of the Titanic wreck. Through a groundbreaking immersive investigation, they uncover the ship’s final moments, shedding light on the acts of heroism and cowardice aboard—and revealing the true story behind the sinking of the “unsinkable” ship.

m1461181.title: Hierarchy
m1461181.overview: In an undisclosed area of Texas after two adoptive brothers become entangled in criminal activity, forced to evade law enforcement and the greedy Russian mafia.

m146233.title: Prisoners
m146233.overview: After his six-year-old daughter is abducted, a desperate father takes justice into his own hands when he loses faith in the detective leading the investigation, setting both men on a collision course as the search descends into obsession and moral compromise.

m1463188.title: Boy George & Culture Club
m1463188.overview: Set against the backdrop of 1980s Britain, four young men – Boy George, Roy Hay, Mikey Craig, and Jon Moss – formed a multi-racial, ethnically diverse, and sexually liberated band with a style and sound that challenged the status quo during the era of New Romantics and Margaret Thatcher’s Britain.

m1465476.title: Lulu Is a Rhinoceros
m1465476.overview: On a quest to spread kindness, fun-loving Lulu embarks on the adventure of a lifetime, powered by new friends, courage, and catchy songs!

m1465591.title: Billy Idol Should Be Dead
m1465591.overview: Punk legend turned pop sensation Billy Idol bares it all in this electrifying documentary, revealing his rise to fame, battle with addiction and triumphant comeback that captivated millions of fans worldwide.

m147.title: The 400 Blows
m147.overview: For young Parisian boy Antoine Doinel, life is one difficult situation after another. Surrounded by inconsiderate adults, including his neglectful parents, Antoine spends his days with his best friend, Rene, trying to plan for a better life. When one of their schemes goes awry, Antoine ends up in trouble with the law, leading to even more conflicts with unsympathetic authority figures.

m147441.title: Exodus: Gods and Kings
m147441.overview: The defiant leader Moses rises up against the Egyptian Pharaoh Ramses, setting 400,000 slaves on a monumental journey of escape from Egypt and its terrifying cycle of deadly plagues.

m14756.title: Ip Man
m14756.overview: A semi-biographical account of Yip Man, the first martial arts master to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. The film focuses on events surrounding Ip that took place in the city of Foshan between the 1930s to 1940s during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

m1479945.title: Wicked: One Wonderful Night
m1479945.overview: Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande lead a one-time-only, two-hour special featuring electrifying performances alongside their Wicked: For Good co-stars for a night of reimagined musical arrangements, cast interviews, behind-the-scenes moments, exclusive surprises, and a sneak peek at Wicked: For Good.

m1480158.title: Terrell & T.O.
m1480158.overview: This feature-length documentary traces the meteoric rise of one of the most talented, accomplished, and polarizing athletes of America's most popular sport and examines his role as the preeminent "prima donna" wide receiver of his era, while catching up with Owens in present-day to see how he is evolving and discovering a new personal path forward.

m1480382.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
m1480382.overview: January 29, 2024. Red Crescent volunteers receive an emergency call. A five-year old girl is trapped in a car under fire in Gaza, pleading for rescue. While trying to keep her on the line, they do everything they can to get an ambulance to her. Her name was Hind Rajab.

m1480387.title: undertone
m1480387.overview: The host of a popular paranormal podcast becomes haunted by terrifying recordings mysteriously sent her way.

m1480856.title: Hanging by a Wire
m1480856.overview: On a Tuesday morning in August 2023, a group of kids set off for school, climbing into a makeshift cable car for the journey across a mountain pass in northwest Pakistan. What happened next would make headlines around the world. Suddenly, 900 feet above the ground, two cables snapped, putting the teenagers in mortal danger.

m14813.title: Mickey's Christmas Carol
m14813.overview: Ebenezer Scrooge is far too greedy to understand that Christmas is a time for kindness and generosity. But with the guidance of some new found friends, Scrooge learns to embrace the spirit of the season. A retelling of the classic Dickens tale with Disney's classic characters.

m1481343.title: The Devil's Mouth
m1481343.overview: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

m1482168.title: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel
m1482168.overview: Explore the formative years of the Red Hot Chili Peppers and the profound influence of original bandmate Hillel Slovak.

m1483525.title: Possible Love
m1483525.overview: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

m14836.title: Coraline
m14836.overview: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, 11-year-old Coraline discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life. In order to stay in the fantasy, she must make a frighteningly real sacrifice.

m1484453.title: Snoopy Presents: A Summer Musical
m1484453.overview: Music and glee fill the air as Charlie Brown and the gang head off to summer camp. First-timer Sally doesn't get what all the hype is about. But when the camp may be forced to close, they team up to save it so more kids can make their own special memories.

m14869.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra
m14869.overview: From the Egyptian desert to deep below the polar ice caps, the elite G.I. JOE team uses the latest in next-generation spy and military equipment to fight the corrupt arms dealer Destro and the growing threat of the mysterious Cobra organization to prevent them from plunging the world into chaos.

m14906.title: Saludos Amigos
m14906.overview: A whimsical blend of live action and animation, "Saludos Amigos" is a colorful kaleidoscope of art, adventure and music set to a toe-tapping samba beat. From high Andes peaks and Argentina's pampas to the sights and sounds of Rio de Janeiro, your international traveling companions are none other than those famous funny friends, Donald Duck and Goofy. They keep things lively as Donald encounters a stubborn llama and "El Gaucho" Goofy tries on…

m1492341.title: Noah Kahan: Out of Body
m1492341.overview: After rocketing to global fame, singer-songwriter Noah Kahan returns to his Vermont roots to get back in tune with himself.

m1493.title: Miss Congeniality
m1493.overview: When the local FBI office receives a letter from a terrorist known only as 'The Citizen', it's quickly determined that he's planning his next act at the Miss America beauty pageant. Because tough-as-nails Gracie Hart is the only female agent at the office, she's chosen to go undercover as the contestant from New Jersey.

m1493400.title: Camp Rock 3
m1493400.overview: When pop group Connect 3 returns to Camp Rock to search for an opening act for their reunion tour, rising tensions and fierce competition among campers test old friendships and spark unexpected romances.

m149509.title: Horns
m149509.overview: In the aftermath of his girlfriend's mysterious death, a young man awakens to strange horns sprouting from his temples.

m1495490.title: Infinite Icon: A Visual Memoir
m1495490.overview: Paris Hilton's musical journey unfolds through rare footage and intimate moments, from her debut album to her latest work. A raw look at her evolution as an artist and icon, blending performances with personal revelations.

m14976.title: Rachel Getting Married
m14976.overview: A young woman who has been in and out from rehab for the past 10 years returns home for the weekend for her sister's wedding.

m149870.title: The Wind Rises
m149870.overview: A lifelong love of flight inspires Japanese aviation engineer Jiro Horikoshi, whose storied career includes the creation of the A-6M World War II fighter plane.

m149871.title: The Tale of The Princess Kaguya
m149871.overview: Found inside a shining stalk of bamboo by an old bamboo cutter and his wife, a tiny girl grows rapidly into an exquisite young lady. The mysterious young princess enthrals all who encounter her. But, ultimately, she must confront her fate.

m150.title: 48 Hrs.
m150.overview: A hard-nosed cop reluctantly teams up with a wise-cracking criminal temporarily paroled to him, in order to track down a killer.

m1500099.title: Versa
m1500099.overview: A young couple looking to start a family who experience emotions—from grief and loss to ultimate joy—as they embark on an ethereal, abstract, and imaginative cosmic dance of life.

m1505013.title: Masaka Kids, A Rhythm Within
m1505013.overview: The story behind the Uganda-based YouTube dance sensations who have endured devastating personal loss from famine and war, and use the power of dance and song to overcome hardship.

m150540.title: Inside Out
m150540.overview: When 11-year-old Riley moves to a new city, her Emotions team up to help her through the transition. Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust and Sadness work together, but when Joy and Sadness get lost, they must journey through unfamiliar places to get back home.

m150689.title: Cinderella
m150689.overview: When her father unexpectedly passes away, young Ella finds herself at the mercy of her cruel stepmother and her daughters. Never one to give up hope, Ella's fortunes begin to change after meeting a dashing stranger in the woods.

m1507696.title: Apocalypse Z: New World
m1507696.overview: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

m1507986.title: The Idaho Student Murders
m1507986.overview: When four University of Idaho coeds are brutally stabbed to death, brilliant criminology student Bryan Kohberger is accused of their murders.

m1508191.title: Ozzy: No Escape from Now
m1508191.overview: Ozzy Osbourne faces his identity and mortality after his world stops. Dealing with health issues and Parkinson's, he questions if he can perform again while music remains his life's cornerstone.

m15121.title: The Sound of Music
m15121.overview: In the years before World War II, a tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey is hired as a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children and brings a new love of life and music into the home.

m1512493.title: LEGO Friends: Heartlake the Musical
m1512493.overview: Young Daisy turns to toy bricks as she finds herself trying to fit into a new school in a new country. When she stumbles across a mysterious key, she is transported to Heartlake City where she makes new friends. But they soon require her help to save a vital local landmark – with plenty of song and dance numbers along the way.

m15138.title: Little Monsters
m15138.overview: A young boy is scared of the monster under his bed. He asks his 6th grade brother to swap rooms for the night as a bet that the monster really exists. Soon the brother becomes friends with the monster and discovers a whole new world of fun and games under his bed where pulling pranks on kids and other monsters is the main attraction.

m15143.title: Some Kind of Wonderful
m15143.overview: Keith Nelson, an artsy high school outcast, tries to land a date with popular girl Amanda Jones with some help from his tomboy best friend, Watts. However, Watts realizes she likes Keith as more than just a friend and tries to convince him to stop pursuing Amanda. Matters are further complicated when Keith's invitation draws the ire of Amanda's rich yet snobby ex-boyfriend, Hardy Jenns, who makes plans to get even.

m15144.title: Sixteen Candles
m15144.overview: With the occasion all but overshadowed by her sister's upcoming wedding, angst-ridden Samantha faces her 16th birthday with typical adolescent dread. Samantha pines for studly older boy Jake, but worries that her chastity will be a turnoff for the popular senior. Meanwhile, she must constantly rebuff the affections of nerdy Ted, who is unfortunately the only boy in school who seems to take an interest in her.

m1515899.title: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
m1515899.overview: Captured during Billie Eilish's sold-out world tour, a concert experience from one of the most celebrated and successful artists of her generation, presented in immersive 3D.

m1516391.title: Cover-Up
m1516391.overview: He's devoted his career to uncovering stories the powerful want buried. From My Lai to Abu Ghraib, dig into the life's work of journalist Seymour Hersh.

m1516698.title: The Last Sunrise
m1516698.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

m1517069.title: Marc by Sofia
m1517069.overview: An intimate, unconventional portrait of Marc Jacobs, crafted by Sofia Coppola to capture the genius and singular universe of the iconic American designer.

m1517409.title: Hollywood Hells
m1517409.overview: When a struggling actress attends an exclusive Hollywood party, she discovers a cabal of power brokers who produce real-life snuff films for the elite. As she fights for her life in the shadowy underbelly of fame, she turns their own cameras against them—becoming not just a survivor, but the director of their final cut.

m1517758.title: Stiller & Meara: Nothing Is Lost
m1517758.overview: Ben Stiller tells the story of his parents—comedy icons Jerry Stiller and Anne Meara—exploring their impact on popular culture and at home, where the lines between creativity, family, life, and art often blurred.

m1518204.title: Allen
m1518204.overview: 20 years after his encounter with an alien, Petey never moved on. Now his old friend has returned, and the reason why is complicated — and unexpected.

m1519084.title: The Merchants of Joy
m1519084.overview: In the city that never sleeps, five families hustle each winter to turn sidewalks into holiday outposts.

m152.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
m152.overview: When an unidentified alien destroys three powerful Klingon cruisers, Captain James T. Kirk returns to the newly transformed U.S.S. Enterprise to take command.

m1523504.title: She Was Here
m1523504.overview: Heather O’Rourke captured hearts as Carol-Anne in the Poltergeist films, a bright light destined for greatness. Her sudden passing at just 12 years old left the world stunned and searching for answers. She Was Here looks beyond the headlines and rumors to honor the girl behind the role: her life, her spirit, and the legacy she left behind.

m152393.title: The Fiction Makers
m152393.overview: Simon Templar is hired by a friend in the book publishing trade to protect one of his stars, a secretive recluse named Amos Klein who writes a popular (and lucrative) series of adventure novels about a manly and suave spy.

m152532.title: Dallas Buyers Club
m152532.overview: Loosely based on the true-life tale of Ron Woodroof, a drug-taking, women-loving, homophobic man who in 1986 was diagnosed with HIV/AIDS and given thirty days to live.

m15263.title: McLintock!
m15263.overview: Aging rancher and self-made man, George Washington McLintock is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife—who left him two years previously—suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in George; she wants custody of their daughter.

m1527153.title: Sharon & Ozzy Osbourne: Coming Home
m1527153.overview: Follow the final three years of Ozzy Osbourne's life as he and Sharon plan a return home after 25 years in LA and prepare for the ultimate farewell gig.

m152742.title: The Best Offer
m152742.overview: Virgil Oldman is a world renowned antiques expert and auctioneer. An eccentric genius, he leads a solitary life, going to extreme lengths to keep his distance from the messiness of human relationships. When appointed by the beautiful but emotionally damaged Claire to oversee the valuation and sale of her family’s priceless art collection, Virgil allows himself to form an attachment to her – and soon he is engulfed by a passion which will rock…

m152747.title: All Is Lost
m152747.overview: During a solo voyage in the Indian Ocean, a veteran mariner awakes to find his vessel taking on water after a collision with a stray shipping container. With his radio and navigation equipment disabled, he sails unknowingly into a violent storm and barely escapes with his life. With any luck, the ocean currents may carry him into a shipping lane -- but, with supplies dwindling and the sharks circling, the sailor is forced to face his own…

m152760.title: The Monuments Men
m152760.overview: Based on the true story of the greatest treasure hunt in history, The Monuments Men is an action drama focusing on seven over-the-hill, out-of-shape museum directors, artists, architects, curators, and art historians who went to the front lines of WWII to rescue the world’s artistic masterpieces from Nazi thieves and return them to their rightful owners.  With the art hidden behind enemy lines, how could these guys hope to succeed?

m15302.title: The Pixar Story
m15302.overview: A look at the first years of Pixar Animation Studios - from the success of "Toy Story" and Pixar's promotion of talented people, to the building of its East Bay campus, the company's relationship with Disney, and its remarkable initial string of eight hits. The contributions of John Lasseter, Ed Catmull and Steve Jobs are profiled. The decline of two-dimensional animation is chronicled as three-dimensional animation rises. Hard work and…

m153518.title: The Angry Birds Movie
m153518.overview: An island populated entirely by happy, flightless birds or almost entirely. In this paradise, Red, a bird with a temper problem, speedy Chuck, and the volatile Bomb have always been outsiders. But when the island is visited by mysterious green piggies, it’s up to these unlikely outcasts to figure out what the pigs are up to.

m1538.title: Collateral
m1538.overview: Cab driver Max picks up a man who offers him $600 to drive him around. But the promise of easy money sours when Max realizes his fare is an assassin.

m1538718.title: Disneyland Handcrafted
m1538718.overview: Oscar and Emmy nominated filmmaker Leslie Iwerks returns with an all-new Disney documentary giving viewers an up-close look at the dedication, effort, and passion that was required to realize a dream that would go on to inspire millions around the world.

m154.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
m154.overview: The starship Enterprise and its crew is pulled back into action when old nemesis, Khan, steals a top secret device called Project Genesis.

m1541.title: Thelma & Louise
m1541.overview: Taking a break from their dreary lives, close friends Thelma and Louise embark on a short weekend trip that ends in unforeseen incriminating circumstances. As fugitives, both women rediscover the strength of their bond and their newfound resilience.

m1541477.title: You, Me, Us
m1541477.overview: A couple faces the difficult path to adoption, determined to become parents despite their complex vulnerabilities.

m1543036.title: The Unstoppable Shirley MacLaine
m1543036.overview: With her short red hair, expressive face, vitality, and playful acting style, Shirley MacLaine stands out in the Hollywood pantheon. Driven by a volcanic personality and iron discipline inherited from classical dance, she has constantly reinvented herself, from the girl next door to the eccentric old lady she plays on screen today, proving at 91 that there is a place for actresses of all ages. A refreshing portrait featuring film clips and…

m15472.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
m15472.overview: Swedish thriller based on Stieg Larsson's novel about a male journalist and a young female hacker. In the opening of the movie, Mikael Blomkvist, a middle-aged publisher for the magazine Millennium, loses a libel case brought by corrupt Swedish industrialist Hans-Erik Wennerström. Nevertheless, he is hired by Henrik Vanger in order to solve a cold case, the disappearance of Vanger's niece

m1548113.title: The Muppet Show
m1548113.overview: Music, comedy, and a whole lot of chaos is bound to ensue when The Muppets once again take the stage of the original Muppet Theatre with their very special guest, Sabrina Carpenter!

m1548556.title: I Was a Teenage Sex Pistol
m1548556.overview: Experience the Pistols' rise to global infamy with an honest, insightful account of a group of malcontents, determined to change the music business and to attack hypocrisy and stale conventions in society at large. Based off the novel written by Glen Matlock, one of the founding members of the Sex Pistols who co-wrote ten of twelve iconic songs on their only studio album, NEVER MIND THE BOLLOCKS. Glen describes in detail the mindset of the UK…

m155.title: The Dark Knight
m155.overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

m15512.title: Monsters vs Aliens
m15512.overview: When Susan Murphy is unwittingly clobbered by a meteor full of outer space gunk on her wedding day, she mysteriously grows to 49-feet-11-inches. The military jumps into action and captures Susan, secreting her away to a covert government compound. She is renamed Ginormica and placed in confinement with a ragtag group of Monsters...

m1555760.title: Something Divine
m1555760.overview: Ray Cappo lead singer of the straightedge hardcore band Youth of Today at the height of their growing popularity, leaves the band and goes to India. Ray becomes the monk Raghunath. What follows is the confluence of two worlds coming together. Hardcore punk and spirituality. Something Divine is a pilgrimage through the holy cites of India and concert halls in America. The film highlights the connection between people of very different…

m1556571.title: The Motel
m1556571.overview: A noir crime drama set in 1970's New York

m15584.title: Dear Zachary: A Letter to a Son About His Father
m15584.overview: In 2001, Andrew Bagby, a medical resident, is murdered not long after breaking up with his girlfriend. Soon after, when she announces she's pregnant, one of Andrew's many close friends, Kurt Kuenne, begins this film, a gift to the child.

m1559456.title: Finding Harmony: A King's Vision
m1559456.overview: In an unprecedented portrait of King Charles III, Finding Harmony: A King's Vision provides intimate insight into His Majesty's passionate quest to reunite humanity with nature. Academy Award-winner Kate Winslet narrates this journey through The King's Foundation's vital work.

m1559776.title: The A List: 15 Stories from Asian and Pacific Diasporas
m1559776.overview: Sandra Oh, Sen. Tammy Duckworth, Kumail Nanjiani, Amanda Nguyen, Connie Chung, and beyond: their worlds may be disparate, but they’ve all, in their unique ways, navigated what it means to be Asian in relation to their American identities. While their success has been fraught with racism, they share their stories of losses and wins.

m1559980.title: The Gospel of Christmas
m1559980.overview: A struggling pastor moves his family to a troubled New York neighborhood, where they must save a neglected church from foreclosure before Christmas.

m1560067.title: The Pink Pill: Sex, Drugs and Who Has Control
m1560067.overview: A documentary that captures a pivotal moment in the ongoing struggle for complete health care equality, at a time when bodily autonomy hangs in the balance.

m156022.title: The Equalizer
m156022.overview: McCall believes he has put his mysterious past behind him and dedicated himself to beginning a new, quiet life. But when he meets Teri, a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters, he can’t stand idly by – he has to help her. Armed with hidden skills that allow him to serve vengeance against anyone who would brutalize the helpless, McCall comes out of his self-imposed retirement and finds his desire for justice…

m1560229.title: Music Box: Happy and You Know It
m1560229.overview: A joyful and surprising journey into the fascinating world of toddler pop, exploring why kids' music is so catchy, can be deeply meaningful, and how AI is taking hold and shaping the industry. Featuring appearances by The Wiggles, Laurie Berkner, and other musicians.

m1561726.title: Masterplan
m1561726.overview: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

m1562.title: 28 Weeks Later
m1562.overview: Twenty-eight weeks after the spread of a deadly rage virus, the inhabitants of the British Isles have lost their battle against the onslaught, as the virus has killed everyone there. Six months later, a group of Americans dare to set foot on the Isles, convinced the danger has passed. But it soon becomes all too clear that the scourge continues to live, waiting to pounce on its next victims.

m1562010.title: Taylor Swift | The Eras Tour | The Final Show
m1562010.overview: Filmed at the end of Taylor Swift's record-breaking Eras Tour in Vancouver, B.C., this complete, in-depth 45-song concert includes the complete 'The Tortured Poets Department' set and special mashups.

m1563925.title: Chris Hemsworth: A Road Trip to Remember
m1563925.overview: In his most personal documentary yet, Chris Hemsworth turns the camera on his own family after his dad’s recent Alzheimer’s diagnosis. They embark on a road trip into their past, exploring the science of social connection and how it can support memory function. They revisit meaningful places and faces, capturing it all as a home movie, and reviving treasured recollections.

m1564614.title: Leviticus
m1564614.overview: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most:  each other.

m1566269.title: The First Snow of Fraggle Rock
m1566269.overview: When the holidays are filled with unexpected adventures and challenges, the Fraggles learn to appreciate each day for being unique and special, like a snowflake.

m1569364.title: Zara Larsson - Up Close
m1569364.overview: The documentary gives us a unique insight into the life of a pop star who broke through at ten years old. We follow her around the world and see a side she's never shown before. This is the story of an artist reaching for the very top, but with the knowledge that no matter how much she achieves, it'll never be enough to satisfy her.

m157.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
m157.overview: A surprise visit from Spock's father provides a startling revelation: McCoy is harboring Spock's living essence.

m1570488.title: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
m1570488.overview: When a medical emergency pulls the Goss family apart, determined dog Winstead will do all he can to bring his humans back together before Christmas Eve.

m1571955.title: Collision Course
m1571955.overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

m1572.title: Die Hard: With a Vengeance
m1572.overview: New York detective John McClane is back and kicking bad-guy butt in the third installment of this action-packed series, which finds him teaming with civilian Zeus Carver to prevent the loss of innocent lives. McClane thought he'd seen it all, until a genius named Simon engages McClane, his new "partner" -- and his beloved city -- in a deadly game that demands their concentration.

m1572196.title: Perilous Passage: Birth in America
m1572196.overview: A look at the impact of an already very precarious maternal health state in the U.S. post-rescinding of Roe v. Wade, via the Supreme Court's Dobbs decision, reversing rights that women have been working so hard to fight for, and that will actually have a deep impact that we can't even see just yet in terms of the numbers of mortality and trauma as a result of those very draconian policies.

m1573.title: Die Hard 2
m1573.overview: One year after his heroics in Los Angeles, John McClane is an off-duty cop who is the wrong guy in the wrong place at the wrong time. On a snowy Christmas Eve, as he waits for his wife's plane to land at Washington Dulles International Airport, terrorists take over the air traffic control system in a plot to free a South American army general and drug smuggler being flown into the US to face drug charges. It's now up to McClane to take on the…

m157336.title: Interstellar
m157336.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

m157353.title: Transcendence
m157353.overview: Two leading computer scientists work toward their goal of Technological Singularity,  as a radical anti-technology organization fights to prevent them from creating a world where computers can transcend the abilities of the human brain.

m157354.title: Fruitvale Station
m157354.overview: Oakland, California. Young Afro-American Oscar Grant crosses paths with family members, friends, enemies and strangers before facing his fate on the platform at Fruitvale Station, in the early morning hours of New Year's Day 2009.

m1574.title: Chicago
m1574.overview: Murderesses Velma Kelly and Roxie Hart find themselves on death row together and fight for the fame that will keep them from the gallows in 1920s Chicago.

m157547.title: Oculus
m157547.overview: A woman tries to exonerate her brother's murder conviction by proving that the crime was committed by a supernatural phenomenon.

m1576.title: Resident Evil
m1576.overview: When a virus leaks from a top-secret facility, turning all resident researchers into ravenous zombies and their lab animals into mutated hounds from hell, the government sends in an elite military task force to contain the outbreak.

m15764.title: Sophie's Choice
m15764.overview: Stingo, a young writer, moves to Brooklyn in 1947 to begin work on his first novel. As he becomes friendly with Sophie and her lover Nathan, he learns that she is a Holocaust survivor. Flashbacks reveal her harrowing story, from pre-war prosperity to Auschwitz. In the present, Sophie and Nathan's relationship increasingly unravels as Stingo grows closer to Sophie and Nathan's fragile mental state becomes ever more apparent.

m1576570.title: This Ordinary Thing
m1576570.overview: A film about non-Jews who saved Jews during the Holocaust.

m1577.title: Resident Evil: Apocalypse
m1577.overview: As the city is locked down under quarantine, Alice finds out that the people that died from the previous incident at the Umbrella Corporation have turned into zombies. She then joins a small band of elite soldiers, who are enlisted to rescue the missing daughter of the creator of the mutating T-virus.  Once lack of luck and resources happen, they begin to wage an exhilarating battle to survive and escape before the Umbrella Corporation erases…

m1578.title: Raging Bull
m1578.overview: The life of boxer Jake LaMotta, whose violence and temper that led him to the top in the ring destroyed his life outside of it.

m1579.title: Apocalypto
m1579.overview: Set in the Mayan civilization, when a man's idyllic presence is brutally disrupted by a violent invading force, he is taken on a perilous journey to a world ruled by fear and oppression where a harrowing end awaits him. Through a twist of fate and spurred by the power of his love for his woman and his family he will make a desperate break to return home and to ultimately save his way of life.

m158011.title: The Call
m158011.overview: Jordan Turner is an experienced 911 operator but when she makes an error in judgment and a call ends badly, Jordan is rattled and unsure if she can continue. But when teenager Casey Welson is abducted in the back of a man's car and calls 911, Jordan is the one called upon to use all of her experience, insights and quick thinking to help Casey escape, and not just to save her, but to make sure the man is brought to justice.

m1580651.title: The Shuffle
m1580651.overview: The story behind the making of the 1985 Chicago Bears' rap anthem and video that became a cultural phenomenon, redefined sports entertainment, and cemented the team's larger-than-life legacy.

m1581.title: The Holiday
m1581.overview: Two women, one American and one British, swap homes at Christmastime following bad breakups. Each woman finds romance with a local man but realizes that the imminent return home may end the relationship.

m1583382.title: Stolen Children
m1583382.overview: The film takes us to Georgia, where the shadows of the post-Soviet past still loom large. At its center is investigative reporter Tamuna Museridze, who sets out to unravel a profoundly personal mystery. As she follows the trail of a widespread 1990s scheme in which newborns were taken from Georgian maternity wards and trafficked across the world, she exposes networks, mechanisms, and long-buried secrets along with family tragedies that remain…

m1584.title: The School of Rock
m1584.overview: Fired from his band and hard up for cash, guitarist and vocalist Dewey Finn finagles his way into a job as a fifth-grade substitute teacher at a private school, where he secretly begins teaching his straight-A students the finer points of rock 'n' roll and the power of sticking it to the man. But as the school’s stern principal closes in and the Battle of the Bands looms, Dewey must risk everything to prove that rock 'n' roll can change lives.

m1584125.title: Breakdown: 1975
m1584125.overview: In 1975, as America faced social and political upheaval, filmmakers turned chaos into art.

m1584619.title: Murder in Monaco
m1584619.overview: Monaco, 1999. One of the world's richest men dies in his penthouse. This documentary unpacks the mysterious murder of billionaire banker, Edmond Safra.

m1584779.title: The Body in the Locker
m1584779.overview: When Amy, the CEO of a major charity, loses her father, she's shocked to discover he owned a mysterious storage locker with a deadly secret inside - the body of a woman. Was her father a murderer? Who was this woman?

m1584780.title: I'm Chevy Chase and You're Not
m1584780.overview: From his Saturday Night Live beginnings to a string of classic comedies, Chevy Chase has always had huge comedic range. He is also a complex and contradictory human being. Featuring revealing interviews with those closest to him, this documentary digs into the talent, flaws, and humanity that shaped an icon.

m1585.title: It's a Wonderful Life
m1585.overview: George Bailey has spent his entire life giving to the people of Bedford Falls.  All that prevents rich skinflint Mr. Potter from taking over the entire town is George's modest building and loan company.  But on Christmas Eve the business's $8,000 is lost and George's troubles begin.

m1585476.title: Kevin Costner Presents: The First Christmas
m1585476.overview: Kevin Costner hosts this special exploring the extraordinary journey of Mary and Joseph as they navigate the hardships, trials and triumphs surrounding Jesus Christ's birth, offering an inspiring way to experience the true meaning of Christmas.

m1586757.title: Beyond Disclosure - The Corey Goode Files
m1586757.overview: After claiming he served 20 years in a secret space program, Corey Goode became a UFO icon - then a lightning rod. This documentary follows his rise and the strange intersection of memory, myth, and media in the age of disclosure.

m1587.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
m1587.overview: Gilbert Grape is a small-town young man with a lot of responsibility. Chief among his concerns are his mother, who is so overweight that she can't leave the house, and his mentally impaired younger brother, Arnie, who has a knack for finding trouble. Settled into a job at a grocery store and an ongoing affair with local woman Betty Carver, Gilbert finally has his life shaken up by the free-spirited Becky.

m1587180.title: Truth and Lies: Who Killed JFK?
m1587180.overview: An exploration of the historical event and the culture of conspiracy surrounding the assassination of former President John F. Kennedy.

m158852.title: Tomorrowland
m158852.overview: Bound by a shared destiny, a bright, optimistic teen bursting with scientific curiosity and a former boy-genius inventor jaded by disillusionment embark on a danger-filled mission to unearth the secrets of an enigmatic place somewhere in time and space that exists in their collective memory as "Tomorrowland."

m1588671.title: Louvre Heist: Minute by Minute
m1588671.overview: Dive into a real-time investigation of the shocking daylight robbery at Paris' Louvre Museum. Former thieves, security staff, eyewitnesses and investigators piece together the crime and ongoing chase to recover France's crown jewels before it's too late.

m158999.title: Blackfish
m158999.overview: Notorious killer whale Tilikum is responsible for the deaths of three individuals, including a top killer whale trainer. Blackfish shows the sometimes devastating consequences of keeping such intelligent and sentient creatures in captivity.

m159137.title: Anita
m159137.overview: The story of young, brilliant African-American Anita Hill who accuses the Supreme Court nominee Clarence Thomas of unwanted sexual advances during explosive Senate Hearings in 1991 and ignites a political firestorm about sexual harassment, race, power and politics that resonates today.

m1591516.title: Evil Influencer: The Jodi Hildebrandt Story
m1591516.overview: Unravel the case of Utah therapist Jodi Hildebrandt, whose child abuse arrest with parenting YouTuber Ruby Franke exposed a twisted tale of manipulation.

m1592.title: Primal Fear
m1592.overview: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.

m1592033.title: Married to El Chapo: Emma Coronel Speaks
m1592033.overview: Swept off her feet by Mexico's most notorious drug lord at just seventeen, Emma Coronel, El Chapo's wife, reflects on her husband's crimes, their tumultuous marriage, and her time in prison, all while grappling with her own accountability.

m1592210.title: Bricks on Track: Building the LEGO F1 Drivers' Parade
m1592210.overview: 10 drivable LEGO Formula 1 cars. 400,000 bricks each. 20 F1 drivers. One unforgettable Miami moment. A behind-the-scenes special revealing how the LEGO Group and Formula 1 pulled off a world-first at the 2025 Miami Grand Prix 2025.

m1592358.title: Peaky Blinders: The Real Story
m1592358.overview: A behind-the-scenes documentary uncovering the real history of Birmingham’s Peaky Blinders, separating fact from fiction in the hit TV series and exploring the creative vision behind its unique style.

m1593.title: Night at the Museum
m1593.overview: Chaos reigns at the natural history museum when night watchman Larry Daley accidentally stirs up an ancient curse, awakening Attila the Hun, an army of gladiators, a Tyrannosaurus rex and other exhibits.

m15947.title: The Three Caballeros
m15947.overview: For Donald's birthday he receives a box with three gifts inside. The gifts, a movie projector, a pop-up book, and a pinata, each take Donald on wild adventures through Mexico and South America.

m1594914.title: Lucky Strike
m1594914.overview: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

m1595325.title: The Anacondas
m1595325.overview: Explorers in Mexico uncover the ruins of an ancient snake-worshiping civilization. Celebration turns to horror when they awaken an ever-growing anaconda, starved of human sacrifices for centuries. Now, the team must band together to survive.

m1595426.title: Jaunt
m1595426.overview: In a stark warehouse office, Justice is weighed down by mounting deadlines and an endless to-do list. But every day, he finds escape in a one-hour ritual that reignites his spirit.

m1596275.title: Drive - The Pretenders
m1596275.overview: A young mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star — officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything — including what's already become so much more than just a deal.

m1596278.title: Time and Water
m1596278.overview: Facing the death of his country’s glaciers and the loss of his beloved grandparents, Icelandic writer Andri Snær Magnason turns his archives into a time capsule to hold what is slipping away — family, memory, time, and water.

m1596285.title: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
m1596285.overview: This documentary recounts Cilvaringz's unlikely rise from fan to Wu-Tang Clan fame — and how the infamous "Once Upon a Time in Shaolin" album came to be.

m1596291.title: Queen of Chess
m1596291.overview: A Hungarian girl dreams of conquering international men’s chess. After a 15-year battle against world champion Garry Kasparov and her domineering father, Judit Polgár revolutionizes the sport’s patriarchal culture to become one of the greatest chess prodigies in history and the greatest woman chess player of all time.

m1596303.title: The Last First: Winter K2
m1596303.overview: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

m1596335.title: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
m1596335.overview: A father-to-be tries to figure out what is happening with all this AI insanity, and explores the most powerful technology humanity has ever created... and what's at stake if we get it wrong.

m1596349.title: Dream Big: The Olympia Movie
m1596349.overview: A global fascination with strength, human performance and physique transformation has created massive commerce, impacting regional economies throughout the world. At the top of this movement is the most prestigious fitness experience in the world - "The Olympia." Dream Big: The Olympia Movie celebrates 60 years of history, passion, and cultural impact behind bodybuilding's ultimate stage.

m1597.title: Meet the Parents
m1597.overview: Greg Focker is ready to marry his girlfriend, Pam, but before he pops the question, he must win over her formidable father, humorless former CIA agent Jack Byrnes, at the wedding of Pam's sister. As Greg bends over backward to make a good impression, his visit to the Byrnes home turns into a hilarious series of disasters, and everything that can go wrong does, all under Jack's critical, hawklike gaze.

m1598022.title: Ozzy Osbourne: The Final Encore
m1598022.overview: From Sabbath to solo, addiction to redemption, the chaotic rise and fall of rock's Prince of Darkness.

m159824.title: Hotel Transylvania 2

m1691022.title: The Hybrids

m1691732.title: Stonehenge: The Final Mystery Revealed

m1695225.title: Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear

m1700680.title: Crazy Magical Mexico

m1701355.title: The Bowens: A Portrait of an American Family

m1768182.title: Dot to Dot: Will I Be Single Forever?
m1768182.overview: Misaki Yamada, 30 and single, has no clear ambitions. After drifting between jobs and places, she works as a care worker until trouble in love and work upends her life. Shiba, 38, avoids close relationships, but takes in his nephew and slowly bonds with him through Yamada. Shimizu, 46, faces caring for her father after years of putting work first. All three search for where they belong.

m17692.title: Jaws 3-D
m17692.overview: A giant thirty-five-foot shark becomes trapped in a SeaWorld theme park and it's up to the sons of police chief Brody to rescue everyone.

m1770631.title: Disney+ Insider: Bluey From Disneyland Resort
m1770631.overview: Get an inside look at “Bluey’s Best Day Ever!” from Disneyland Resort in Southern California with the voices of Bluey’s Mum and Dad — Melanie Zanetti and David McCormack.

m1771.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
m1771.overview: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort. Rogers must stop the Red Skull – Adolf Hitler's ruthless head of weaponry, and the leader of an organization that intends to use a mysterious device of untold powers for world domination.

m1771323.title: Super Scam Me
m1771323.overview: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims.

m1771844.title: Kate Berlant: Parmesan
m1771844.overview: Seamlessly weaving through personal stories and stream-of-consciousness epiphanies, Kate Berlant offers up reflections on everything from the moon, to her destructive relationship to technology, to the evolving nature of sexuality.

m1772976.title: Kill. Bury. Print.
m1772976.overview: When the McCurtain Gazette, a small family-run newspaper, begins reporting on alleged sex, drugs, and violence within the county sheriff's office, they find themselves the target of the sheriff's retaliation. Tensions escalate when the paper obtains a secret recording revealing the sheriff and local officials allegedly discussing having the family killed, turning a local investigation into international news.

m1773759.title: Seriously Single Too
m1773759.overview: Dineo and Noni — besties meant to take on the party scene together — suddenly face their biggest fear when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously propose.

m177572.title: Big Hero 6
m177572.overview: A special bond develops between plus-sized inflatable robot Baymax, and prodigy Hiro Hamada, who team up with a group of friends to form a band of high-tech heroes.

m1776531.title: Clown Panic
m1776531.overview: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze.

m177677.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
m177677.overview: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet—eradicating 'The Syndicate', an International and highly-skilled rogue organization committed to destroying the IMF.

m1777.title: Fahrenheit 9/11
m1777.overview: Michael Moore's view on how the Bush administration allegedly used the tragic events on 9/11 to push forward its agenda for unjust wars in Afghanistan and Iraq.

m1780005.title: Surviving Hurricane Otis
m1780005.overview: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.

m1780067.title: Chocolate for Christmas
m1780067.overview: When a woman returns home to save her family’s beloved chocolate shop, she finds unexpected love and a renewed appreciation for what matters most. This sweet holiday romance celebrates family, community and the lasting power of tradition.

m1780407.title: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
m1780407.overview: Eager to get off Santa's naughty list, Snoopy goes all out to be the nicest beagle in town.

m1782831.title: Beyond Top Secret: The Era of Disclosure
m1782831.overview: Dr. Steven Greer leads the charge toward ultimate disclosure. Bringing forward firsthand military whistle-blowers, the film exposes the decades-long institutional cover-up surrounding off-world technology and classified programs.

m1787736.title: Heather McMahan: By a Thread
m1787736.overview: Everyone’s stressed. We’re all hanging on BY A THREAD. But don’t worry, we can all laugh about it together. BY A THREAD. October 16. Hulu.

m1788.title: Footloose
m1788.overview: When teenager Ren and his family move from big-city Chicago to a small town in the West, he's in for a real case of culture shock after discovering he's living in a place where music and dancing are illegal.

m1789549.title: The Birthday​ Gift​
m1789549.overview: Single mother Marlene Frischmann organizes a birthday party for her son Theo at her brother's chic country villa, which quickly spirals into family drama, world-view quarrels, and chaos.

m17898.title: Silver Bullet
m17898.overview: The small city of Tarker's Mills is startled by a series of sadistic murders. The population fears the work of a maniac, but sightings of a mysterious, hairy creature soon spread. People lock themselves up at night, but there's one boy who's still outside…

m1790050.title: Disney+ Insider: Worlds Collide Concert Tour
m1790050.overview: Descendants. Zombies. And now, Camp Rock. Three fan-favorite worlds are finally colliding on one stage. Go behind the scenes of the "Worlds Collide Concert Tour" with hosts Trevor Tordjman and Jordan Clark as they get insider access hours before the doors open — seeing an empty venue transform into an all-new arena spectacular.

m1790935.title: Instadocs: AI Gone Wild
m1790935.overview: Did AI just commit a felony? "Instadocs" investigates the Hugging Face hack and why this cyberattack may be a warning shot for humanity's future.

m1792914.title: Log 15
m1792914.overview: Driven to save her mother from Alzheimer's, a desperate woman documents her radical experiments to unlock the human mind, only to discover the footage she is recording is actively rewriting her own reality.

m1794569.title: Unprotected: Murder in Galicia
m1794569.overview: Documentary film that tells the story of Isabel Fuentes. In April 2015, alleged burglars left her on the brink of death in her own home, in the village of Pazos, in Verín. From the very beginning, the Guardia Civil sergeant in charge of the case suspected that the account of what had happened did not add up and tried to protect Isabel from further attack.

m1795661.title: A Christmas Ornament to Remember
m1795661.overview: A big city veterinarian rushes home to help her family recover from a devastating storm and save the tree lighting, but finds her mission complicated when a mysterious Christmas ornament arrives and sets her back on a path back to love.

m1795663.title: A Proper Christmas
m1795663.overview: When her beloved British grandmother Iris arrives just in time for Christmas, Nora, a warm-hearted small-town schoolteacher and devoted single mom, finds her carefully ordered life beginning to shift in ways she never anticipated. Settling into their cozy coastal Southern town, Iris brings with her six generations of family Christmas ornaments, an arsenal of proper British recipes, and an unmistakable talent for gentle meddling.

m1795934.title: Theo Von: I'm Doing Fine
m1795934.overview: Comedian and chart-topping podcaster Theo Von returns to Netflix with his third stand-up special and his first in five years. The comedian opens up about the wild world that raised him, from his back-road upbringing to acid-filled adventures, in this revealing stand-up hour.

m1797392.title: Kordell Stewart / Slash & Burn
m1797392.overview: For a generation of football fans, former Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Kordell "Slash" Stewart was one of the most electrifying players of the 1990s. But just as he became one of football's biggest stars, a malicious rumor upended his life. Through candid interviews with Stewart and others who witnessed his brightest and darkest moments, explore the personal toll of scrutiny beyond the football field while searching for the truth behind a…

m17979.title: A Christmas Carol
m17979.overview: Miser Ebenezer Scrooge is awakened on Christmas Eve by spirits who reveal to him his own miserable existence, what opportunities he wasted in his youth, his current cruelties, and the dire fate that awaits him if he does not change his ways. Scrooge is faced with his own story of growing bitterness and meanness, and must decide what his own future will hold: death or redemption.

m1798383.title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
m1798383.overview: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

m1799196.title: #Vymara
m1799196.overview: Four washed-up creators livestream their search for a missing YouTuber linked to a conspiracy and uncover a sinister truth never meant to go viral.

m18.title: The Fifth Element
m18.overview: In 2263, a taxi driver is unintentionally given the task of saving a young girl who is part of the key that will ensure the survival of humanity.

m180.title: Minority Report
m180.overview: John Anderton is a top 'Precrime' cop in the late-21st century, when technology can predict crimes before they're committed. But Anderton becomes the quarry when another investigator targets him for a murder charge.

m1800082.title: A Richer Christmas
m1800082.overview: When a wealthy family loses everything before the holidays, their world falls apart — but in the chaos, they discover the true meaning of Christmas.

m1801282.title: Homeless
m1801282.overview: The story of Pairoj Pichetmetakul, an artist who decided to leave his hometown of Bangkok and pursue his dreams in New York for nearly a decade.

m1802058.title: CMA Presents I Will Always Love You: A Celebration of Dolly Parton
m1802058.overview: A celebration of the artist, songwriter, entertainer, humanitarian and entrepreneur whose music and generosity carried her from the mountains of east Tennessee into the hearts of generations around the world.

m1802220.title: Sharks: Reef Rivals
m1802220.overview: Follows scientists investigating why huge numbers of sharks gather in a dangerous lagoon on Australia's Great Barrier Reef, revealing a complex battleground.

m1802228.title: Shark vs. Giant Croc
m1802228.overview: Shark experts Nico Lubitz and Adam Barnett head into the wilds of northeastern Australia to investigate reports of bull sharks and saltwater crocodiles clashing along the Daintree River. Who's the top dog? Attempting to fit a camera to the back of a big territorial boss croc, they risk all to find out.

m1802229.title: Shark Island Showdown
m1802229.overview: At remote Norfolk Island in the South Pacific, shark experts Lauren Meyer, Adam Barnett and Charlie Huveneers investigate why tiger, dusky, and Galapagos sharks gather here in such high numbers. Through daring dives, tracking technology and bold experiments, they uncover hidden nurseries, shark hierarchies and a rare predator hotspot.

m1802464.title: Meethe Mein Kya Hai
m1802464.overview: A young widower's grief eases at a joyful Diwali reunion — until his sister's surprise marriage throws the family into chaos.

m1802674.title: Hot Wheels Let's Race: Attack of the T-Rex
m1802674.overview: When a giant T-Rex threatens Hot Wheels City, it's up to Coop and his friends to race to the rescue and save the day.

m1803635.title: Matty Ryan: Live in Chicago
m1803635.overview: Matty Ryan has shares stories about being too high for 7-11, billionaires stealing blood from their teen sons, how mummies started COVID, and much more. He turns small annoyances into big laughs, rides the line between chaos and charm.

m1804941.title: Mike Tyson: Return of the Mike
m1804941.overview: The former heavyweight champion returns to the stage for a raw one-man show, turning his wildest life stories into comedy gold at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino.

m1807796.title: Broken Road
m1807796.overview: A struggling college student fumbles his way through the stress that comes with it. Missing and failed assignments lead to a very dangerous way of coping with his problems.

m1807926.title: LARA - The Man Who Took on Escobar

m1808393.title: Reptilians: They Walk Among Us
m1808393.overview: They wear our faces, shape our destiny, and have waited through the ages for the perfect moment to rise, igniting a spiritual battle for our future.

m180863.title: T2 Trainspotting
m180863.overview: After 20 years abroad, Mark Renton returns to Scotland and reunites with his old friends Sick Boy, Spud and Begbie.

m1809199.title: Zainab Johnson: Toxically Optimistic
m1809199.overview: Zainab Johnson has a gun revelation, a Tesla crisis and an unshakable belief that she can find the upside in everything in this sharp stand-up hour.

m18094.title: Anvil! The Story of Anvil
m18094.overview: At 14, best friends Robb Reiner and Lips made a pact to rock together forever. Their band, Anvil, hailed as the "demi-gods of Canadian metal" influenced a musical generation that includes Metallica, Slayer, and Anthrax. Following a calamitous European tour, Lips and Robb, now in their fifties, set off to record their 13th album in one last attempt to fulfill their boyhood dreams.

m1810122.title: BAILAR O MORIR
m1810122.overview: The most influential artists of Argentine pop step out of their own universes to create BOM.

m1810711.title: Dilwali Diwali
m1810711.overview: Ansh Sikkha returns to his Punjabi family home for Diwali after years working abroad. As the Sikkas gather for the festival, their clashing views on what constitutes a fulfilling life create friction and connection.

m1811741.title: Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell
m1811741.overview: Instadocs goes inside the rape investigation and Jane Doe lawsuit at Cornell University, with the student journalists at the forefront of the story.

m1813355.title: A Story of Derry
m1813355.overview: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

m1814761.title: Last Stream
m1814761.overview: Desperate for views, a fading streamer stages a fake haunting connected to an unsolved case. The stream spirals into a real-time nightmare watched by tens of thousands and someone in the chat seems to know exactly how the night will end.

m18148.title: Tokyo Story
m18148.overview: The elderly Shukishi and his wife, Tomi, take the long journey from their small seaside village to visit their adult children in Tokyo. Their elder son, Koichi, a doctor, and their daughter, Shige, a hairdresser, don't have much time to spend with their aged parents, and so it falls to Noriko, the widow of their younger son who was killed in the war, to keep her in-laws company.

m181533.title: Night at the Museum: Secret of the Tomb
m181533.overview: When the magic powers of The Tablet of Ahkmenrah begin to die out, Larry Daley spans the globe, uniting favorite and new characters while embarking on an epic quest to save the magic before it is gone forever.

m1815440.title: A Christmas Destiny
m1815440.overview: Five years after one unforgettable Christmas Eve together, Serena and Jarrod cross paths again, except now, they’ve both moved on, and neither one is single.

m1815857.title: Amazon Music Live: Doja Cat
m1815857.overview: Doja Cat Performing The Vie Tour Live At The Forum.

m1816668.title: Ninho: Fame Ain’t Worth It
m1816668.overview: At the height of his success in 2025, French rap star Ninho considers leaving music behind. This documentary looks back on the triumphs, sacrifices and personal challenges that brought him to that crossroads.

m1817.title: Phone Booth
m1817.overview: A slick New York publicist who picks up a ringing receiver in a phone booth is told that if he hangs up, he'll be killed... and the little red light from a laser rifle sight is proof that the caller isn't kidding.

m1817773.title: High End: The Watch Theft Ring
m1817773.overview: Investigates Chile's high-profile Caso Relojes ("Watch Case") scandal, in which a suitcase full of smuggled luxury watches and jewelry unmasked an illicit underground network, connecting criminal elements to Chile's social elite.

m181808.title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
m181808.overview: Rey develops her newly discovered abilities with the guidance of Luke Skywalker, who is unsettled by the strength of her powers. Meanwhile, the Resistance prepares to do battle with the First Order.

m181812.title: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
m181812.overview: The surviving Resistance faces the First Order once again as the journey of Rey, Finn and Poe Dameron continues. With the power and knowledge of generations behind them, the final battle begins.

m181886.title: Enemy
m181886.overview: A mild-mannered college professor discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs.

m18196.title: The Sentinel
m18196.overview: As a young girl, Alison Parker attempted suicide after being traumatized by her father's sexual exploits. Now an elite fashion model, she moves to a Brooklyn Heights apartment building where she encounters a number of bizarre, eccentric tenants and attempts to uncover the building's sinister secret.

m1820162.title: Right in Front of You
m1820162.overview: A struggling widow has less than two weeks to save her home. As romance blossoms, a shocking secret threatens her last chance at a fresh start.

m1820172.title: Janelle James: How Romantic
m1820172.overview: In her debut hour-long stand-up special, Janelle James sounds off on body counts, bank accounts and why women should wrestle men.

m1821645.title: Frozen: Biggest Sledding Adventure Ever!
m1821645.overview: Snow has arrived in Arendelle, and Anna and Olaf are excited for their first sled ride of the winter! When the hills aren't thrilling enough, Elsa uses her ice magic to create an epic sledding course filled with giant jumps, twists, and icy surprises. But when royal duties call Elsa away, Anna and Olaf come up with a special plan to bring the winter fun back and surprise their sister.

m1822227.title: Tadej Pogacar: Anatomy of a G.O.A.T.
m1822227.overview: Through expert analysis and first-hand insights, this documentary examines the genetics, mindset and team support that have helped make Tadej Pogačar one of cycling's most successful riders.

m1822260.title: Christmas to the Rescue
m1822260.overview: Four foster kids on the run find shelter in a mansion after rescuing a stray dog. When they uncover a robbery plot, they risk everything to stop it—earning a second chance at family and love by Christmas

m1822838.title: El último rescate en la Patagonia
m1822838.overview: In the heart of the arid Patagonian desert, a mission as improbable as it is urgent comes to life: to rescue two fossilized dinosaur nests that could contain intact embryos. Boris, director of the paleontological museum in Lamarque—a small town in the remote Middle Valley of Río Negro—leads this unique expedition.

m18239.title: The Twilight Saga: New Moon
m18239.overview: Forks, Washington resident Bella Swan is reeling from the departure of her vampire love, Edward Cullen, and finds comfort in her friendship with Jacob Black, a werewolf. But before she knows it, she's thrust into a centuries-old conflict, and her desire to be with Edward at any cost leads her to take greater and greater risks.

m1824.title: 50 First Dates
m1824.overview: Henry is a player skilled at seducing women. But when this veterinarian meets Lucy, a girl with a quirky problem when it comes to total recall, he realizes it's possible to fall in love all over again…and again, and again. That's because the delightful Lucy has no short-term memory, so Henry must woo her day after day until he finally sweeps her off her feet.

m1825.title: Over the Top
m1825.overview: Lincoln Hawk a hard-luck big-rig trucker takes us under the glaring Las Vegas lights for all the boisterous action of the World Armwrestling Championship. Relying on wits and willpower, Hawk tries to rebuild his life by capturing the first-place prize money, and the love of the son he abandoned years earlier into the keeping of his rich, ruthless father-in-law.

m1830.title: Lord of War
m1830.overview: Yuri Orlov is a globetrotting arms dealer and, through some of the deadliest war zones, he struggles to stay one step ahead of a relentless Interpol agent, his business rivals and even some of his customers who include many of the world's most notorious dictators. Finally, he must also face his own conscience.

m18360.title: Night at the Museum: Battle of the Smithsonian
m18360.overview: Hapless museum night watchman Larry Daley must help his living, breathing exhibit friends out of a pickle now that they've been transferred to the archives at the Smithsonian Institution. Larry's (mis)adventures this time include close encounters with Amelia Earhart, Abe Lincoln and Ivan the Terrible.

m184315.title: Hercules
m184315.overview: When a new enemy threatens the innocent, Hercules must lead his fearless team of warriors in a battle against overwhelming odds.

m184345.title: A Haunted House 2
m184345.overview: After exorcising the demons of his ex, Malcolm starts afresh with his new girlfriend and her two children. After moving into their dream home, Malcolm is once again plagued by bizarre paranormal events.

m184346.title: Deliver Us from Evil
m184346.overview: When a frightening wave of violence sweeps through New York City, troubled cop Sarchie fails to find a rational explanation for the bizarre crimes. However, his eyes are opened to a frightening alternate reality when renegade Jesuit priest Mendoza convinces him that demonic possession may be to blame for the gruesome murders. Together, they wage a valiant supernatural struggle to rid the city of an otherworldly evil.

m1844.title: Entrapment
m1844.overview: Two thieves, who travel in elegant circles, try to outsmart each other and, in the process, end up falling in love.

m18491.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The End of Evangelion
m18491.overview: SEELE orders an all-out attack on NERV, aiming to destroy the Evas before Gendo can advance his own plans for the Human Instrumentality Project. Shinji is pushed to the limits of his sanity as he is forced to decide the fate of humanity.

m185.title: A Clockwork Orange
m185.overview: In a near-future Britain, young Alexander DeLarge and his pals get their kicks beating and raping anyone they please. When not destroying the lives of others, Alex swoons to the music of Beethoven. The state, eager to crack down on juvenile crime, gives an incarcerated Alex the option to undergo an invasive procedure that'll rob him of all personal agency. In a time when conscience is a commodity, can Alex change his tune?

m18533.title: Bronson
m18533.overview: A young man who was sentenced to 7 years in prison for robbing a post office ends up spending 30 years in solitary confinement. During this time, his own personality is supplanted by his alter ego, Charles Bronson.

m18570.title: Food, Inc.
m18570.overview: Documentary filmmaker Robert Kenner examines how mammoth corporations have taken over all aspects of the food chain in the United States, from the farms where our food is grown to the chain restaurants and supermarkets where it's sold. Narrated by author and activist Eric Schlosser, the film features interviews with average Americans about their dietary habits, commentary from food experts like Michael Pollan and unsettling footage shot…

m1858.title: Transformers
m1858.overview: Young teenager Sam Witwicky becomes involved in the ancient struggle between two extraterrestrial factions of transforming robots – the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. Sam holds the clue to unimaginable power and the Decepticons will stop at nothing to retrieve it.

m186.title: Lucky Number Slevin
m186.overview: Slevin is mistakenly put in the middle of a personal war between the city’s biggest criminal bosses. Under constant watch, Slevin must try not to get killed by an infamous assassin and come up with an idea of how to get out of his current dilemma.

m18647.title: One-Eyed Jacks
m18647.overview: Running from the law after a bank robbery in Mexico, Dad Longworth finds an opportunity to take the stolen gold and leave his partner Rio to be captured. Years later, Rio escapes from the prison where he has been since, and hunts down Dad for revenge. Dad is now a respectable sheriff in California, and has been living in fear of Rio's return.

m1865.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
m1865.overview: When Jack crosses paths with a woman from his past, he's not sure if it's love...or if she's a ruthless con artist using him to find the fabled Fountain of Youth.

m187017.title: 22 Jump Street
m187017.overview: After making their way through high school (twice), big changes are in store for officers Schmidt and Jenko when they go deep undercover at a local college. But when Jenko meets a kindred spirit on the football team, and Schmidt infiltrates the bohemian art major scene, they begin to question their partnership. Now they don't have to just crack the case - they have to figure out if they can have a mature relationship. If these two overgrown…

m18706.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
m18706.overview: In the midst of World War II, Sherlock Holmes rescues the Swiss inventor of a new bomb-sight from the Gestapo and brings him to England, where he quickly falls into the clutches of the evil Professor Moriarty.

m18736.title: The Lizzie McGuire Movie
m18736.overview: Lizzie McGuire has graduated from middle school and takes a trip to Rome, Italy with her class. And what was supposed to be only a normal trip, becomes a teenager's dream come true.

m188166.title: Blue Ruin
m188166.overview: When the quiet life of a beach bum is upended by dreadful news, he sets off for his childhood home to carry out an act of vengeance. However, he proves an inept assassin and finds himself in a brutal fight to protect his estranged family.

m1883.title: Malcolm X
m1883.overview: A tribute to the controversial black activist and leader of the struggle for black liberation. He hit bottom during his imprisonment in the '50s, he became a Black Muslim and then a leader in the Nation of Islam. His assassination in 1965 left a legacy of self-determination and racial pride.

m18846.title: The Little Drummer Boy
m18846.overview: After being kidnapped and escaping, young drummer boy Aaron searches for his camel and finds him in the Nativity of the Baby Jesus. Aaron gives Baby Jesus the only gift he has, a song on his drum.

m1885.title: The Karate Kid
m1885.overview: New Jersey teen Daniel LaRusso moves to Los Angeles with his mother, and soon strikes up a relationship with Ali. He quickly finds himself the target of bullying by a group of thugs, led by Ali's ex-boyfriend Johnny, who study karate at the Cobra Kai dojo under ruthless sensei John Kreese. Fortunately, Daniel befriends Mr. Miyagi, an unassuming repairman who just happens to be a martial arts master himself. Miyagi takes Daniel under his wing,…

m1887.title: Marie Antoinette
m1887.overview: A retelling of the story of France’s iconic but ill-fated queen, Marie Antoinette - from her betrothal and marriage to Louis XVI at fifteen to her reign as queen at nineteen and ultimately the fall of Versailles.

m188927.title: Star Trek Beyond
m188927.overview: The USS Enterprise crew explores the furthest reaches of uncharted space, where they encounter a mysterious new enemy who puts them and everything the Federation stands for to the test.

m189.title: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
m189.overview: Some of Sin City's most hard-boiled citizens cross paths with a few of its more reviled inhabitants.

m1891.title: The Empire Strikes Back
m1891.overview: The epic saga continues as Luke Skywalker, in hopes of defeating the evil Galactic Empire, learns the ways of the Jedi from aging master Yoda. But Darth Vader is more determined than ever to capture Luke. Meanwhile, rebel leader Princess Leia, cocky Han Solo, Chewbacca, and droids C-3PO and R2-D2 are thrown into various stages of capture, betrayal and despair.

m1892.title: Return of the Jedi
m1892.overview: Luke Skywalker leads a mission to rescue his friend Han Solo from the clutches of Jabba the Hutt, the Emperor prepares to crush the Rebellion with a more powerful Death Star, and the Rebel fleet mounts a massive attack on the space station. Luke Skywalker confronts Darth Vader in a final climactic duel before the evil Emperor.

m1893.title: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
m1893.overview: Anakin Skywalker, a young slave strong with the Force, is discovered on Tatooine. Meanwhile, the evil Sith have returned, enacting their plot for revenge against the Jedi.

m1894.title: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
